title: Molecular formula
summary: Element counts constrain candidates without specifying connectivity or stereochemistry.
zh_summary: 元素数目约束候选物，但不指定连接关系或立体化学。

title: Isomer
summary: The same molecular formula can describe different structures; isobars are a different distinction.
zh_summary: 相同分子式可以对应不同结构；同量异位物种涉及另一种区别。

title: Spectral library
summary: Reference spectra and metadata support comparison without making the top hit automatically correct.
zh_summary: 参考谱与元数据支持比较，但不会使首位命中自动正确。

title: Lipid shorthand notation
summary: Encode the lipid structural details actually established by the experiment.
zh_summary: 编码实验实际建立的脂质结构细节。

title: Ion mobility
summary: Ion motion through gas under an electric field, with coordinate and condition definitions that matter.
zh_summary: 离子在电场作用下穿过气体的运动；坐标和条件定义至关重要。

title: Collision cross section
summary: A model-derived ion–gas collision quantity whose comparability requires specified conditions.
zh_summary: 由模型推导的离子–气体碰撞量；可比性需要明确条件。
